jony-kids-english.shows: The hero, the course cards, the results carousel, the price plans and the sign-up modal — filled, never sent.
notes: Parent review screenshots are blurred during capture and kept out of frame.
The sign-up form is filled with sample values and never submitted; all writes were blocked.

level-up.shows: The pinned hero panels, the results counting up beside the radar, the 3D result-card stack and the growth path.

jony-math.shows: The interactive multiplication table in the hero, the ten outcomes, the four-week plan and the sign-up form.
notes: The sign-up form is filled with sample values and never submitted; all writes were blocked.

flashy.shows: A dashboard filled by real study sessions, a flashcard round with self-rating, a multiple-choice test with feedback, and progress.
notes: Seeded with FLASHY’s own built-in sample set through the real import screen. The statistics shown come from flashcard and quiz sessions actually run in the app before recording.

brain-train.shows: The mascot welcome, choosing an age, the whole app re-theming as colours are picked, and choosing subjects.

coma.shows: A motion piece built from COMA’s real rules: the schedule read from a group title, the homework window, the roll-call trap, the verdict and the weekly score.
notes: No user interface exists to record. Rendered from capture/motion/coma; message texts are illustrative and labelled so on screen, rules and figures come from the code and its tests.
Silent by decision: no one has listened to a soundtrack for it yet.

xn-crm.shows: A quick tour: the director’s dashboard, groups, students, finance and debts, the weekly timetable, attendance, cash flow and analytics.
notes: Recorded from the real application running locally against a throwaway database. Every school, student, family and phone number on screen is invented demo data.

jony-taxi.reason: Every screen past sign-in needs a Supabase backend (auth, REST, realtime). All 27 migrations and the seed were applied to a local Postgres here, but no local Supabase stack could be started: its container images could not be pulled, and running a downloaded API server binary was not permitted in this session. Finding while doing so: the trip generator (generate_daily_trips, migrations 0021/0023/0027) reads centers.seat_capacity and centers.stop_interval_min, which no migration creates — a database built from the migrations alone cannot generate trips.
jony-taxi.needs: A throwaway Supabase project with the migrations and seed applied (plus the two missing columns), or permission to run a local PostgREST for capture.

ish-ritmi.reason: The public build opens on sign-in; getting past it means a real account on the production database.
ish-ritmi.needs: A demo account, or a build pointed at a throwaway Supabase project.

link-board.reason: Opens on phone-and-PIN sign-in; signing up to record it would write to the production database.
link-board.needs: A demo account with a few saved links.
